slides.title: Advanced OOP Features
content: Advanced OOP features enhance flexibility and modularity of programs
They include abstraction, interfaces, static members, and inner classes
These concepts help in designing scalable and maintainable systems
They build on basic OOP principles like inheritance and polymorphism

slides.title: Abstraction
content: Abstraction means hiding implementation details and showing only essential features
Focuses on what an object does instead of how it works
Example: Using a car without knowing engine details

slides.title: Abstract Classes
content: Abstract class cannot be instantiated directly
Can contain abstract and concrete methods
Used as a blueprint for subclasses

slides.title: Key Points of Abstract Class
content: Can have constructors but cannot create objects
Supports code reuse using concrete methods
Used when partial implementation is required

slides.title: Interfaces
content: An interface defines a contract for classes
Classes must implement all methods of interface

slides.title: Features of Interfaces
content: All methods are abstract by default (before Java 8)
Variables are public, static, and final

slides.title: Interface vs Abstract Class
content: Abstract class can have both abstract and concrete methods
Class can extend only one abstract class

slides.title: Default Methods in Interfaces
content: Default methods have implementation inside interface
Can be overridden by implementing classes

slides.title: Static Methods in Interfaces
content: Static methods belong to interface, not objects
Can be called without creating object

slides.title: Static Keyword in Java
content: Static members belong to class, not objects
Used for common data and methods

slides.title: Static Variables
content: Shared across all objects of a class
Used for common data like counters

slides.title: Static Methods
content: Can be called without creating object

slides.title: Inner Classes
content: Used for better organization of code

slides.title: Static Nested Classes
content: Do not need outer class object
Access only static members of outer class

slides.title: Non-Static Inner Classes
content: Can access all members of outer class
Used when inner class depends on outer class
More flexible than static nested classes

slides.title: Local Inner Classes
content: Can access final or effectively final variables

slides.title: Anonymous Inner Classes
content: Commonly used with interfaces or abstract classes
